definition: Addendum means an extra section added at the end of a book or document.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word addendum. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know addendum should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: When the state grant arrived after the budget was printed, the clerk issued a one-page addendum with the revised totals.
A margin note is far slighter than an addendum — a reader's pencil scribble beside one paragraph, meant mostly for oneself, where an addendum is a whole printed section formally joined to the end.
A postscript stops short of an addendum — a line or two slipped in after the signature, while an addendum arrives as a full section built onto the end of the work.

An appendix is reference material planned from the start — tables, maps, and source lists the author always meant to attach at the back. An addendum is the unplanned arrival: it patches in what surfaced only after the text was finished. Both sit at the end; only an addendum comes late.

An insert is a loose extra sheet tucked between a document's pages, never bound in as part of the work. An addendum is formally joined on and becomes part of the document itself. Shake the binder and the insert falls out; the addendum stays put.

The first edition of 'Gulls of the Northern Coast' went to press in March, its plates painted, its index set, its back matter complete.
In May, a birder photographed a black-tailed gull off the headlands — a species the guide's range maps said should not exist within a thousand miles.
Reprinting the whole book would have cost more than the small press earned in a year.
Pulping it was unthinkable.
The publisher chose the old remedy: a four-page addendum, bound into every later printing behind the index, with the new sighting, a corrected map, and one apologetic footnote.
Collectors now prize the awkward first printings, but working birders want the later copies — the ones whose ending grew to admit what the sea sent after the text was finished.
